pages.text: All circles share one golden center and height. Small uses a 7 by 7 footprint with 16 glyphs; medium uses 11 by 11 with 28; large uses 15 by 15 with 40. Outer circles add to the inner rings. Purifying Earth requires 44 white glyphs in total.
For medium: at north/south offset 5, mark east/west offsets -2 through +2. At offset 4, mark east/west +/-3; at offset 3, mark +/-4. Across the middle five rows, mark +/-5.

For large: at north/south offset 7, mark east/west -3 through +3. At offset 6 mark +/-4; at offset 5 mark +/-5; at offset 4 mark +/-6. Across the middle seven rows mark +/-7. Perception requires all three rings in white. Colored circles support custom recipes and later rituals.

A ritual checks each required glyph type both at activation and during casting. A missing or wrongly colored required glyph stops it. Only unconsumed offerings are returned; Hungry Flames and continuous rituals consume them at startup. Extra glyphs outside required rings do not prevent casting.
